samples.title: Taller keycaps: Proof strip
samples.statement:
A repair clerk waits for a taller keycap before closing each unresolved height ticket. Alma rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

For every reading, produce the distance to the first strictly larger reading to its right, or 0 if none exists.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement tallerKeycapsProofStrip(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Taller keycaps: Peak ticket
samples.statement:
A repair clerk waits for a taller keycap before closing each unresolved height ticket. Luz is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

For every reading, produce the distance to the first strictly larger reading to its right, or 0 if none exists.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement tallerKeycapsPeakTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

samples.title: Taller keycaps: Boss receipt
samples.statement:
A repair clerk waits for a taller keycap before closing each unresolved height ticket. Ivo adds numbered weights to the final receipt at the unit's inspection desk. The first derived reading has weight one, so its position matters as much as its value.

For every reading, produce the distance to the first strictly larger reading to its right, or 0 if none exists.

Return the weighted sum of the derived sequence: multiply its first value by 1, its second by 2, and so on, then add the products. Return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement tallerKeycapsBossReceipt(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
